channels.detail: The release tag and GitHub Release do not exist before the release commit is merged.
The npm artifact must be verified directly after tag publication.
The PyPI wheels and sdist must be verified directly after tag publication.
All version-pinned crate archives must be verified after dependency-ordered publication.
The version-pinned rustdoc endpoint must be checked after crates.io publication.
The deployed documentation must display v1.0.37 after the release commit reaches main.
